project.name: Federation Admin Control Plane
project.claim: TheHub is the sole federation-global administrative control plane; six producer apps are bounded operational planes; TheHub iOS is a bounded read-only companion.

evidence.description: TheHub full local suite passed 1041 tests with 12 explicit skips and zero failures.
All 68 signed operations have exactly one privilege binding and permit only thehub_workstation execution.
Six producer isolation scans passed across 2198 tracked source and workflow files.
Seven-node federation governance passed with five versioned contracts.
The iOS source and server contract expose only five read capabilities and no workstation manager access.
GitHub CI, macOS build, iOS simulator, merge protection, deployment smoke, production audit and rollback evidence are not available before publication.

requirements.title: Sole workstation execution boundary
acceptance_criteria: All signed operations are workstation-only and unclassified operations fail closed
requirements.notes: Bounded to local source and tests.

requirements.title: Unconfigured writes fail closed
acceptance_criteria: No private-network fallback permits administrative writes without a token

requirements.title: Six producer applications lack global authority
acceptance_criteria: Every producer has an exact bounded manifest and zero prohibited authority markers
requirements.notes: Source manifestation proof; binary proof awaits CI artifacts.

requirements.title: Boundary registered in Impact Lockstep
acceptance_criteria: Contract change impacts all seven nodes and cannot certify with a missing disposition
requirements.notes: Remote branch protection and coordinated PR enforcement unverified.

requirements.title: Bounded iOS companion
acceptance_criteria: Only five read capabilities ship and manager execution is impossible

requirements.title: All seven coordinated PR checks pass
acceptance_criteria: All affected repository checks are green at frozen PR SHAs

requirements.title: macOS workstation and iOS simulator build
acceptance_criteria: Native workstation and companion build/test on supported Apple runners

requirements.title: Deployment smoke, audit and rollback proof
acceptance_criteria: Deployment, immutable audit, outage and rollback gates pass
